resident_telemetry.wait_scope: host wall time blocked in fence waits, including upload; not GPU kernel time

centered rectangle half width along GL +X, half height along GL +Y at shape angle pi/2

basis_sources.reference: installed SAPIEN 3.0.3 public headers and shipped rt shader
